description.narrative: New phase of the Afghanistan Joint Response to respond to the high needs of affected children and their families in Nangarhar. The project will focus on provision of 1- Health (primary and natal care, including to new borns, health and child protection awareness and nutrition monitoring), 2- Food Security & Livelihoods (vocational training to youth to support their income generating activities and protect them from exploitation) and multi-purpose cash to families of children (with Case Management) to improve the children’s living conditions.
